title: Retry default set to 0 attempts; client loop never sends the request

pr_metadata.title: Disable retries by default
pr_metadata.body: Retries hid real outages; opt in explicitly.

labels.defect: Semantics of MaxAttempts changed (attempts → retries) with the default 0, while the loop still treats it as total attempts
labels.evidence: Do() now iterates zero times: the request is never sent and Do returns nil (no error) — every caller believes the call succeeded.

labels.defect: Loop bound assumes MaxAttempts counts the first attempt
labels.evidence: for i := 0; i < MaxAttempts; i++ with MaxAttempts = 0 executes zero sends and returns a nil error.
